anna (People Ops): Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Starting a short follow-up thread for Q&A items, links, and owners. :wave:

omar (CEO): Quick recap: priority shift toward reliability + predictability; Dedicated in more regions this year; Private deployments continue but on a slower cadence.

anna (People Ops): Recordings & slides: https://internal.redwood.ai/ah/1991112223/rec ; https://docs.redwood.ai/ah/q2-roadmap . Follow-up doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/ah/1991112223-actions (editable).

mike (Product): Roadmap clarity: Dedicated GA = Q3; limited early access late Q2 for pilots. Private/on-prem pilot targeted Q4 (legal & infra dependencies).

maria (Eng): Engineering priorities called out: (1) batching/autoscale improvements (INF-3401); (2) KV persistence for lower tail latency (INF-3405). Spike planned next sprint.

lucy (Platform): Multi-region Dedicated effort = INF-3410. Need Sales to confirm pilot customer list by 2026-04-30 so we can size capacity. @sales-team please ping Mike.

sales-team: noted, will assemble list and share with @mike by 2026-04-28.

anna (People Ops): Action items with owners / dates:
- Post recording + slides 1min  anna  done
- Follow-up doc created 1min  anna  done
- Pilot customer list 1min  sales-team (cc: mike)  2026-04-28
- Multi-region ops plan (INF-3410) 1min  lucy  2026-05-01
- Latency spike (INF-3401) 1min  maria/mike  2026-04-15
- Fallback config examples (INF-3415) 1min  maria  2026-04-10

mike (Product): Pricing draft for Dedicated in partner portal: https://internal.redwood.ai/pricing/dedicated-draft. Feedback welcome.

lucy (Platform): Note: HSM/KMS integration requirement for some Private customers tracked as SEC-215; legal engaged.

maria (Eng): Small technical Q from QA: is the fallback policy global or per-tenant by default?

omar (CEO): Default = global with per-tenant overrides. We'll add a config example to docs.

maria (Eng): Ill add a sample snippet to the follow-up doc (INF-3415) showing a route config example.

allhands-bot: Reminder: company follow-up survey closes in 72 hours  https://internal.redwood.ai/surveys/ah-q2

anna (People Ops): If you see missing items, reply here and Ill update the doc. Ill send a company summary tomorrow morning. Thanks!
